name: Great Border War & Field Battle
description: Two imperial hosts clash in a decisive field engagement, leaving thousands of fallen and shattered banners.
creativePrompt: What disputed province was the cause of war? Which heroic cavalry charge decided the day?
exampleNarrative: Steel met steel on the muddy floodplains, sixty thousand men locked in a deafening storm of arrows, pikes, and blood.

name: Protracted Fortress Siege & Sapping
description: Invest an unbreached border fortress with catapults, sapper tunnels, and disease over a bitter winter siege.
creativePrompt: How long did the defenders hold out on boiled leather and rainwater before the walls crumbled?
exampleNarrative: For nine months trebuchet stones pounded the outer walls until a sapper explosion collapsed the western gatehouse.

name: Peasant & Underclass Uprising
description: Oppressed serfs and miners rise with scythes and torches, burning manor houses and declaring freedom.
creativePrompt: What charismatic folk hero or prophet leads the peasant revolt? What are their demands?
exampleNarrative: Torches illuminated the night as thirty thousand pitchfork-wielding peasants marched upon the lordly manor houses.

name: Dynastic War of the Pretenders
description: A sudden royal death splits the kingdom between two rival cousins claiming the rightful crown.
creativePrompt: Which great houses back the elder brother, and which champion the charismatic younger sister?
exampleNarrative: Brother turned sword on brother across the realm as rival heralds proclaimed competing monarchs on the same throne.

name: Zealot Inquisitorial Purge
description: Religious zealots take power, burning heretical scrolls and executing accused sorcerers in public squares.
creativePrompt: What ancient religious scripture was deemed forbidden heresy? How do underground believers hide?
exampleNarrative: Pyres of forbidden books and condemned scholars lit the midnight sky as black-robed inquisitors purged the university.

name: Privateer Naval Blockade
description: Rogue privateers and naval squadrons strangle a rival capital maritime trade, starving its grain supplies.
creativePrompt: Which admiral was secretly commissioned by a rival prince to fly the black pirate flag?
exampleNarrative: Corsair galleons formed a deadly cordon across the harbor narrows, burning every merchant ship that attempted to run the blockade.

name: Border Scorched Earth Raids
description: Lightning cavalry raids burn granaries and bridges along the border, denying forage to advancing hosts.
creativePrompt: What bitter grievance drove the raiders to burn the fertile harvest right before winter?
exampleNarrative: Fast-riding horse archers torched the outlying villages and vanished into the hills before the garrison could mobilize.

name: War of the Awakening Titans
description: Arcane superweapons shatter the crust, awakening two colossal elemental titans in cataclysmic clash.
creativePrompt: How does the clash between mountain and sea titans physically reshape the world map?
exampleNarrative: The heavens tore as two thousand-foot colossi collided, each blow cracking mountains and boiling coastal bays.
